Daredevil Impulse
TARGET IMMUNITY:
10
TARGET RANGE:
650 / 725 / 800 / 875 / 950 (based on level)
SPEED:
2050 • 2800
Innate: Samira's basic attacks and damaging abilities against enemy champions that are unique from the previous hit generate a Style stack, up to 6. Samira can attack immobilized enemies to rapidly fire a barrage of bolts at them. If she is slightly outside of her attack range, she will also dash into it, then fire. Additionally, attacking champions and monsters that are knocked up will knock them up again briefly.
This effect cannot occur on the same target more than once every few seconds. Innate: Samira's sword deals bonus magic damage to enemies based on their missing health. She uses her sword when she casts certain abilities or attacks enemies within melee range. Innate - Style: Each stack grants bonus movement speed and an increasing grade from E to S.
Innate: Samira's damaging basic attacks and abilities against at least one enemy champion unique from the previous damaging hit made against champions generate a stack of Style for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent unique or non-unique hits and stacking up to 6 times.
Style: For each stack, Samira gains 2.75% / 3% / 3.25% / 3.5% (based on level) bonus movement speed, up to a maximum of 16.5% / 18% / 19.5% / 21% (based on level). At maximum stacks, Samira can cast Inferno Trigger.
Innate: Samira's basic attacks against targets within 200 units of her use her blade, becoming non-projectile. Blade attacks, Blade Whirl, Wild Rush, and the slash and explosives of Flair deal 2 – 21 (based on level) (+ 3.5% – 11.32% (based on level) AD) bonus magic damage, increased by 0% – 100% (based on target's missing health), up to 4 – 42 (based on level) (+ 7% – 22.65% (based on level) AD).
Samira's basic attack against an immobilized target is empowered to have an uncancellable windup and fire 6 bolts over 0.5 seconds, each dealing 17% AD physical damage and applying life steal. If the target is a monster or is airborne, the attack also knocks them up for 0.5 seconds.
The empowered attack resets Samira's basic attack timer, is affected by critical strike modifiers, applies on-hit effects only once, and cannot occur on the same target more than once every few seconds.
If the target is further away from Samira's attack range, initiating an attack against the immobilized target while within valid range of them will first cause her to dash toward them up to her attack range, then automatically cast the bolts.

The Style stack count is represented by the grades to the left of Samira's health bar, visible to the player only, as well as a stack counter under the health bar, visible to all players. No grade is represented by just on Inferno Trigger's ability icon.
Abilities blocked by spell shields will still grant Samira Style stacks.
Style stacks can be generated via clones.
Gun and blade attacks do not count as different for the purposes of stacking Style.
Basic attacks using the blade are still classified as ranged.
The blade attack's range condition is unaffected by attack range modifiers (e.g. Rapid Firecannon).
Its attack range is calculated edge-to-edge, as normal (i.e., size modifiers on Samira or her target can still increase the effective distance as basic attack range is added onto unit size).
The blade attack bonus deals default damage.
The blade attack bonus does not apply against structures.
The blade attack bonus applies after the primary damage of the attack and is not an on-hit effect.
The empowered attack's bolts deal:
Basic damage for the first bolt, as a basic attack would.
Default damage for all subsequent bolts.
Each bolt from the empowered attack rolls for a critical strike separately.
The empowered attack will trigger on immobilizes from any source.
It specifically cannot trigger against enemies affected by Blast Cone's displacement triggered by anyone.(unexpected)
The empowered attack will not trigger against crowd control immune and displacement immune targets.
Fiora's Riposte can resist the knock up from Daredevil Impulse, but the ability will not trigger its on- immobilization empowerment condition from the attack alone.(unexpected)
Samira may dash and have her dash to an immobilized target canceled an indefinite number of times, so long as the empowered attack has not triggered. When the empowered attack begins, Daredevil Impulse's cooldown is applied on the target which also prevents her from initiating the dash and the attack again on them for the duration.
The on-target cooldown will start even if the empowered attack is parried.
While grounded or rooted, Samira cannot dash into range to use the empowered attack. She can only use it if her target is within her attack range while under this condition.
The empowered attack will not apply the knock up against suspended enemies.
The empowered attack will only apply the knock up if the target is still immobilized or airborne upon being hit. It will not apply if they are no longer disabled when hit.
The empowered attack cannot be used against a target with a spell shield.
The application of the knock up effect can occur on any of the bolts of the empowered attack if it had not already occurred on the first.
A missile that is parried by Riposte or is dodged, blocked, or misses while Samira is blinded cannot apply the knock up in any way.
The empowered attack's speed is unaffected by attack speed modifiers.
If Samira is outside maximum initiation range for the dash when targeting an immobilized target, the player must input a new Attack order on the target upon entering initiation range in order to actually initiate the dash.
However if Samira enters the bolts' cast range via her movement while the target is still immobilized without issuing any other commands, the empowered attack will cast without requiring a new order (without the dash).
The empowered attack removes any forced movement affecting the target once its knock up ends.(unexpected)
PENDING FOR TEST: Does this also happen if it's cleansed.
Tips & Tricks
Samira can target enemies affected by Dragon's or Baron Nashor's displacing attacks and abilities with the empowered attack/dash, allowing for an unexpected initiation or quick poke.

Wielding black-powder pistols and a custom-engineered blade, Samira thrives in life-or-death circumstances, eliminating any who stand in her way with flash and flair.
